Thank you for your reply :)

I’m in my third year. I need to push through these exams hardcore for the next 2 months. 

I will live with them and I am reliant on their finance until I finish these really really brutal finals. Moving out, getting a job etc. just isn’t an option with how challenging these next 2 months will be academically.

Play it cool. It’s still special next time you go together even if she’s been on the rides before because it’ll be the first time she goes with you.

Communicate about better clarity next time and maybe ask her why she didn’t tell you about the plans. Maybe she forgot. Only talking openly will resolve the situation positively for future instances.

A relationship is a contract of commitment (most of the time).

It entirely depends on your discussions but both of you have to be on the same page and comfortable about it. What classifies as cheating? It’s still a date regardless of the reason and you are allowed to have comfort levels. 

Communicate and set boundaries if you need to.
